definition: to be stained by dirt, dust, filth, etc.
example_en: The clothes he played in the rain got stained with dirt.

definition: (pl.) the five faces of Śiva, - Sadyōjāta, Vāmadēva, Aghōra, Tatpuruṣa and Īśāna.
example_en: There is an idol of Shiva's five faces in the temple.

definition: a heavy iron lever with one end forged into a wedge; a crow-bar.
example_en: They used a crow-bar to demolish the wall.

definition: to unite, associate oneself with.
example_en: The two friends united for a common goal.

definition: a tract of land being cultivated.
example_en: He takes good care of his cultivated land.

definition: the light supposed to be arising from the soul; the divine lustre.
example_en: That saint's divine soul-lustre astonished everyone.

definition: to shoot or hurl a stone using a catapult.
example_en: The boy shot a stone with a catapult at the bird.

definition: to test critically and evaluate (something).
example_en: The teachers critically evaluated the students' answers.

definition: a variety in coconut trees whose nuts are reddish brown or red in colour.
example_en: A red-nut coconut tree caught the eye in the garden.

definition: the work of inlaying rubies (into ornaments).
example_en: The goldsmith did the work of inlaying rubies in the ornament.

definition: one who plays a musical instrument.
example_en: That instrument player plays the veena well.

definition: the quality or condition of being clean, pure, spotless; cleanliness; immaculateness.
example_en: Maintaining the cleanliness of the house is everyone's responsibility.

definition: the earth.
example_en: Mountains stand tall upon the earth.

definition: the soft and flexible external covering or integument of an animal body; the skin.
example_en: In the sun, his skin turned black and burned.

definition: a reason or cause.
example_en: There must be some reason why he did not come.

definition: the plant Basella rubra of Basellaceae family; Indian spinach.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಹಿತ್ತಲಿನಿಂದ ಕಾವುಬಚ್ಚಲೆ ಸೊಪ್ಪನ್ನು ಕೊಯ್ದು ತಂದಳು.
example_en: Grandmother plucked and brought Indian spinach leaves from the backyard.

definition: a kind of aquatic animal.
example: ಕೊಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಳ್ಳಿ ಎಂಬ ಜಲಚರ ಪ್ರಾಣಿ ಕಂಡುಬಂತು.
example_en: The aquatic animal called mallli was seen in the pond.

definition: a diety, whose food is ambrosia.
example_en: The devotees worship the ambrosia-eating deity with devotion.

definition: common salt, natural sodium chloride, occurring in solid form; rock-salt.
example_en: Rock-salt is used for cooking.

definition: a three-legged stool of low height; a tripod.
example_en: The old woman sat on the low three-legged stool.

definition: a kind of potherb.
example_en: A dish of bilavaraga greens is good for health.

definition: the duration of a person's life; lifetime.
example_en: His lifetime was very short.

definition: throbbing, palpitating rapidly.
example_en: The heart was throbbing rapidly out of fear.

definition: a kitchen vessel, used to cook food.
example_en: Mother cooked rice in the vessel.

definition: to come in (long) queue.
example_en: People came in a long queue for tickets.

definition: a professional wrestler.
example_en: That professional wrestler was very powerful.

definition: without means of subsistence; lacking food, clothing, and shelter; utterly poor; destitute.
example_en: That destitute man was begging on the street.

definition: a wild boar (Sus scrofa).
example_en: A wild boar escaped from the hunters in the forest.

definition: the condition or fact of being congruent; agreement; harmony.
example_en: The harmony of colours made the painting beautiful.

definition: the forehead of an elephant.
example_en: The elephant's forehead was broad.

definition: to jump or leap forward.
example_en: The boy leapt forward onto the highway.

definition: a stop or break in speaking or reading, which clarifies meaning; a pause.
example: ಕವಿ ಪದ್ಯದ ನಡುವೆ ಒಂದು ವಿಚಿತಿಯನ್ನು ನೀಡಿದನು.
example_en: The poet gave a pause in the middle of the verse to clarify its meaning.

definition: the sky that is red, that is, with reddish clouds ( caused by the refraction of sunlight, while the sun is rising or setting).
example_en: The reddish evening sky was very beautiful to look at.

definition: weight; heaviness.
example_en: The bag's weight was heavy, it was hard to lift.

definition: the naturally elevated and inclined ground; unevenness.
example: ಆ ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ದಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಏರುಪೇರು ಬಹಳ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a lot of unevenness on that hill path.

definition: a step of a flight of steps or of stairs, ladder, etc.
example_en: One step of the staircase is broken.

definition: a sacrificial hall.
example_en: The priests performed the sacrifice in the sacrificial hall.

definition: to become bad or useless.
example_en: Without proper care the crop became useless.

definition: a water jug.
example_en: She filled the water jug with cold water.

definition: an old man.
example: ಆ ಕಳವ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಕಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That old man used to tell village stories to the children.

definition: to write, produce a story.
example: ಆ ಲೇಖಕ ಒಂದು ಹೊಸ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯನ್ನು ಕತೆಕಟ್ಟಿದನು.
example_en: That writer wrote a new novel.

definition: Vāyu, the Wind-God whose vehicle is an antilope.
example_en: The Wind-God has the deer as his vehicle.

definition: a military projectile used in ancient warfare to hurl heavy objects against the defensive wall of the fortified place of one's enemy.
example: ಸೈನಿಕರು ಡೇಂಕಣೆಯನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ ಕೋಟೆಯನ್ನು ಒಡೆಯಲು ಯತ್ನಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The soldiers tried to break the fort using a projectile.

definition: a preparation; plan; arrangements.
example_en: The arrangements for the meeting are ready.

definition: (hist.) a particular kind of tax levied by a government.
example_en: The government levied a tax on the land.

definition: obstructed; checked; hindered; stopped.
example_en: The construction work remained obstructed without permission.

definition: the harvesting season.
example: ಹಂಗಾಮ ಬಂದಾಗ ಇಡೀ ಊರು ಗದ್ದೆ ಕೆಲಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಗ್ನವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: When the harvesting season comes, the whole village is engrossed in field work.

definition: the unchangeable or eternal state.
example: ಆತ್ಮವು ಧ್ರುವಗತಿಯನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಅವರು ನಂಬಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: They believed that the soul attains the unchangeable state.

definition: a staying hidden and waiting for a chance.
example_en: The hunter stayed hidden in the bush waiting for a chance.

definition: a yarn or a thread of high quality.
example_en: This sari has been woven with high quality yarn.

definition: the middle to large sized tree Hymenodictyon excelsum of Rubiaceae family.
example: ದೋಢಿ ಮರವು ದೊಡ್ಡದಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದು ನೆರಳು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The Hymenodictyon excelsum tree grows large and provides shade.

definition: of, relating to or involving all the limbs.
example_en: This exercise is good for overall (all-limb) health.

definition: a unit of capacity equal to two koḷagas (an old measure).
example_en: The oil-presser sold one ikkuḷa of oil.

definition: a strong, thick cord, made of twisted or braided strands of hemp, flax, coir or the like; a rope.
example_en: The farmer brought a rope to tie the oxen.

definition: a petition in which summary of a complaint or grievance is mentioned.
example: ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಕುಂದನ್ನು ಪೂಟರ್ಜಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಕ್ಷಿಪ್ತವಾಗಿ ಬರೆದನು.
example_en: He wrote his grievance briefly in the petition summary.

definition: the plant Kirganellia reticulata ( = Phyllanthus reticulatus, = P. multiflorus) of Euphorbiaceae family.
example_en: A Kirganellia reticulata plant has grown in the corner of his courtyard.

definition: a camphor crystal.
example_en: During the worship, they lit the camphor crystal.

definition: the state of being torn.
example_en: That agreement was in a state of being torn apart.

definition: income generated from an enterprise; earnings.
example_en: The company's earnings increased this year.

definition: a discharging or removing or being discharged or removed from office or service, etc.; dismissal; removal.
example_en: The government dismissed that employee.

definition: the ground plan of a building.
example_en: The engineer prepared the ground plan of the house.

definition: to catch, seize the end (of something).
example_en: He caught and seized the end of the rope.

definition: matted hairs.
example_en: Matted hair had grown on the ascetic's head.

definition: to spread (one's) plumage (as a peacock while dancing).
example_en: On hearing the music, the peacock spread its plumage and danced.

definition: a temporary stay; sojourn.
example_en: Their stay in the village lasted only a few days.

definition: the tip of the foot.
example_en: A thorn pricked and blood came from the tip of his foot.

definition: the state of being broken, dilapidated.
example: ಆ ಮನೆಯ ಮುರಕಳಿ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಯನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ಬೇಸರವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Seeing the dilapidated condition of that house made me sad.

definition: a kind of acute, inflammatory virus disease, characterised of blisters on the body.
example_en: The blistering viral disease causes blisters all over the body.

definition: the site of a battle; battlefield.
example_en: The soldiers bravely marched forward towards the battlefield.

definition: the millet grass Panicum miliaceum of Poaceae family.
example_en: The farmers grew the small millet grass on the hill slope.

definition: (a liquid) to be collected at a place in substantial quantity (as to look like a pond).
example_en: The rainwater was collecting like a pond in the low ground.

definition: jaundice - a) a condition in which the eyeballs, the skin, and the urine become abnormally yellowish as a result of increased amounts of bile pigments in the blood b) popularly, a disease causing this condition, as hepatitis.
example: ಕಾಮಣಿ ಬಂದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವನ ಕಣ್ಣು ಹಳದಿಯಾಯಿತು.
example_en: After he contracted jaundice, his eyes turned yellow.

definition: a variety of fig tree.
example_en: That variety of fig tree had grown in the forest.

definition: to make greater, as in size, quantity or strength; to increase; to enlarge; to augment.
example_en: He increased his wealth.

definition: to offer money or a valuable as a bet or stake; to stake; to wager.
example_en: Both friends staked a bet on the cricket match.

definition: faithful; loyal.
example_en: He was a faithful servant to his master.

definition: anything that is opposite, unfavourable or harmful to righteousness, virtue, moral conduct, etc.
example_en: The guru taught that corruption is an obstacle to righteousness.

definition: a downward slant of a land surface; an inclined surface; a slope.
example_en: The children were playing on the slope.

definition: the hollow under the arm at the shoulder; the armpit; axilla.
example_en: She carried the child on her arm, close to her armpit.

definition: the fact of being unable to remember.
example_en: The old man has an inability to remember recent matters.

definition: that much of food which can be chewed at a time; bolus; morel.
example: ಅವನು ಒಂದು ಒಣಿಗೆ ಅನ್ನವನ್ನು ಬಾಯಿಗೆ ಹಾಕಿದನು.
example_en: He put a bolus of rice into his mouth.

definition: the act of refusing, disowning or casting off.
example: ಅವನ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯ ನಿರಾಕರಣ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The refusal of his demand surprised everyone.

definition: The Supreme, who pervades the whole universe.
example_en: The devotees worshipped the Supreme, who pervades the universe, with devotion.

definition: the future results or consequence of an action; effect.
example: ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಕೆಲಸದ ಉದರ್ಕ ಎಂದಿಗೂ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯದೇ ಆಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The future consequence of a good deed is always good.

definition: always; at all times.
example_en: She is always smiling.

definition: any large container for liquid or gas; a tank.
example_en: There is a big tank on the roof of the house.

definition: a small room or apartment in a house.
example_en: There was a small room in that house.

definition: to talk caustically or remark sarcastically.
example_en: He always talks caustically and provokes people.

definition: the inside of the nails of people.
example: ಉಳ್ಳುಗುರ್ ಕೆಂಪಗೆ ಇದ್ದರೆ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: They say that if the inside of the nails is red, one's health is good.

definition: the state or condition of being the same in power, value, rank, etc.; equality; parity.
example_en: There was parity between the two kings.

definition: suddenly; immediately; quickly.
example_en: The door opened suddenly and quickly.

definition: a temporary stay (as on one's journey); a sojourn.
example: ಪ್ರಯಾಣದ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ಅವರು ಒಂದು ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಕಾಂ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: During their journey they made a temporary stay in a town.

definition: the plant Linum usitatissimum, of Linaceae family, which yields linen; common flax; linum.
example_en: Cloth spun from flax fibre is very good.

definition: a man who hurries busily or with much fuss and bother; a hustler.
example_en: The hustler was running back and forth in the market.

definition: the act of drawing or squeezing milk from the mammary glands of (a cow, buffalow etc.); milking.
example: ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಹಸುವಿನ ಸಂದೋಹ ಮುಗಿಸಿ ಅವನು ಹಾಲು ಮಾರಲು ಹೋದನು.
example_en: After finishing the milking of the cow in the morning, he went to sell the milk.

definition: a kind of fire works, that burns with bright light, when lit.
example_en: On the festival day the firework burned and lit up the sky.

definition: a battle or combat.
example: ಆ ಹೋರು ಇಡೀ ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಭವಿಷ್ಯವನ್ನೇ ಬದಲಿಸಿತು.
example_en: That battle changed the very future of the entire kingdom.

definition: to make something become loose; to loosen.
example_en: He loosened the knot a little and untied it.

definition: any of the various senna plants belonging to the family Caesalpiniaceae family, esp. Cassia pumila.
example: ಔಷಧಿಗಾಗಿ ಅವರು ತಗಸಿ ಗಿಡದ ಎಲೆ ಬಳಸಿದರು.
example_en: They used the leaves of the tagasi plant for medicine.

definition: the skill in and understanding of erotic matters.
example_en: That scholar was an expert in the science of erotic matters.

definition: love; affection; fondness.
example_en: A mother's love for her children never diminishes.

definition: the act or profession of supervising the routine works in a temple, monastery, palace, toll-gate, etc.
example_en: He was given the responsibility of supervising the temple's routine works.

definition: strong dislike or ill will; hatred; animosity.
example: ಆ ಕುಟುಂಬದವರ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹಳೆಯ ಸೇಡು ಇನ್ನೂ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: Old hatred still remained in the minds of that family.

definition: displaced from a higher place to a lower one; fallen.
example_en: They picked up the picture that had fallen from the wall.

definition: (one's ability, strength, courage, etc.) to be weakened.
example_en: His strength became weakened due to the long illness.

definition: to go, move forward; to proceed.
example_en: The soldiers proceeded forward towards the enemies.

definition: to become flat (and thinner); to be flattened.
example_en: The ball left in the sun got flattened by pressure.

definition: (pl.) the five artisans of a village - carpenters, goldsmiths, blacksmiths, masons and braziers (or, according to some, carpenters, weavers, barbers, washermen and cobblers).
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಪಂಚಕಾರುಕರು ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಅಗತ್ಯ ವಸ್ತುಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾಡಿಕೊಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: The five village artisans used to make necessary goods for everyone.

definition: either of the two feathered forelimbs of a bird, either or not fully developed for flying, for flight, balance in running, for swimming, etc.; a wing.
example_en: The sparrow's wings were of many colours.

definition: a kind of long robe covering from the shoulder to the knee.
example_en: That person was wearing a beautiful long robe.

definition: cancer - a) a malignant new growth anywhere in the body of a person or animal that tends to spread locally and to distant parts of the body; b) any of various diseases characterised by the uncontrolled growth of cells that disrupt body tissue, metabolism, etc.
example_en: It was found through tests that she had cancer.

definition: not tilled; uncultivated.
example_en: Weeds had grown on the uncultivated land.

definition: to display vanity or coquetry.
example: ಅವಳು ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಡ್ಡುದೋಱಿ ಜನರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆದಳು.
example_en: She displayed coquetry in the gathering and drew people's attention.

definition: a reply given rudely showing deliberate disregard to the other person; an oppugnant, arrogant answer.
example_en: Everyone was surprised hearing his arrogant reply.

definition: an injury done to living tissue by a cut or blow etc., esp. beyond the cutting or piercing of the skin.
example_en: The injury caused by the fall has not healed yet.

definition: originated, made or produced long back.
example: ಅವನ ಬಟ್ಟೆಗಳು ಹಳದು, ಹೊಸತು ಒಂದೂ ಇರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: His clothes were old, there was not even one new one.

definition: a sanyāsi, the Hindu ascetic, of the highest order.
example_en: The highest-order ascetic was meditating in a Himalayan cave.

definition: the fellow-feeling or genuine concern for other's well being; compassion.
example_en: Her words were full of compassion.

definition: old (and worn out) clothes; rags.
example_en: That beggar was shivering with cold in his worn-out old clothes.

definition: a small path.
example_en: One can go to the village by that small path.

definition: a flat metallic disk that gives a loud, resonant tone when struck, usu. used at the time of waving lights before the deity either in a temple or at house; a gong.
example_en: At the time of the waving of lights, they strike the gong.

definition: a complete destruction of something or an instance of being destructed.
example_en: The cyclone brought complete destruction to the town.

definition: the state of being cut, broken or minced into small piece.
example_en: The plate that fell shattered into small pieces.

definition: to carry; to convey.
example_en: The workers carried the sacks to the godown.

definition: a group, assemblage, etc. of servants.
example_en: A group of servants had gathered in front of the palace.

definition: a fake coin; a counterfeit currency.
example_en: A fake coin was found in the pocket.

definition: the quality or state of being very modest.
example_en: Her extreme modesty won everyone's admiration.

definition: a pair of dissimilar conductors joined at two points to form a closed circuit so as to produce a thermoelectric current when the junctions are at different temperatures; a thermo-couple.
example_en: Using a thermocouple, the difference in temperature can be measured.

definition: the range of one's sight.
example_en: The distant hill went beyond the range of my sight.

definition: to cause to slip away.
example_en: He caused the rope to slip away from his hand.

definition: a spiritual teacher of mean qualities; a despicable teacher.
example_en: The despicable teacher's teaching misled the people.

definition: excitement from pleasure or excessive joy.
example_en: On hearing the result, she felt great excitement of joy.

definition: brightly; brilliantly; sparklingly.
example_en: The silver vessels gleamed brightly in the sunlight.

definition: an open course for horse-racing.
example_en: The horses ran fast on the open race course.

definition: the tree Cleistanthus collinus of Euphorbiaceae family.
example_en: There are trees of the kaadumara species on that hill.

definition: a restraining, compelling or constraining by force; coercion.
example_en: Due to the officials' coercion, the farmers had to give up their land.

definition: the tree Saymida febrifuga of Meliaceae family; bastard cedar; Indian redwood.
example: ಅರಣ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಗೋರಖಮುಂಡಿ ಮರ ಬೆಳೆದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A large Indian redwood tree had grown in the forest.

definition: a pod - a) a long seed vessel esp. of a leguminous plant, e.g. a pea; b) the cocoon of a silkworm; c) the case surrounding locust eggs.
example_en: She broke the pea pod and took out the seeds.

definition: a weapon usu. of metal with a blade and hilt with a hand guard, used esp. for thrusting or striking; a short sword.
example_en: The soldier had a short sword fastened to his waist.

definition: the chief of a military regiment.
example_en: The regiment chief set out for the border with the troops.

definition: a kind of paddy.
example_en: The gavuge variety of paddy is grown mostly in this region.

definition: small dots or scars (of any colour) on the skin.
example: ಅವಳ ಮುಖದ ಮೇಲೆ ಚಿಮಕಲುಮಚ್ಚೆ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Small scars were clearly visible on her face.

definition: the practice of tricks to deceive; artifice; deception; trickery.
example_en: That magician's deceptive artifice fooled the spectators.

definition: a kind of medicinal substances made using five substances (Chinese pepper, clarified butter, sugar, honey and milk).
example: ವೈದ್ಯ ರೋಗಿಗೆ ಪಸಾರ ಎಂಬ ಔಷಧಿ ಸೂಚಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The doctor prescribed the medicine called pasāra to the patient.

definition: to drive (a vehicle, horse, etc.) fast.
example_en: He rode the horse driving it fast.

definition: a shouting; a cry; a loud call.
example_en: A loud shout was heard from the top of the hill.

definition: (going or talking) angrily.
example: ಅವನು ಸಿಡಕ್ಕನೆ ಮಾತನಾಡುತ್ತಾ ಕೋಣೆ ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಹೋದನು.
example_en: He left the room, speaking angrily.

definition: holding; possessing; having the possession of.
example_en: He has come to possess a lot of property.

definition: a species of fish.
example_en: The fishermen caught the bompu fish in the net.

definition: a measurable distance between two points or things.
example: ಈ ಎರಡು ಊರುಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಪಾಸಲೆ ಬಹಳ ದೂರವಿದೆ.
example_en: The distance between these two towns is very great.

definition: to face towards.
example_en: He stood facing towards the temple.

definition: a man fond of talking too much; a talkative man.
example_en: That talkative man is always chattering unnecessarily.

definition: a place from where something originates, is supplied, etc.; the original source.
example: ಈ ನದಿಯೇ ಈ ಪ್ರದೇಶದ ನೀರಿನ ಪುಟ್ಟುಗಣಿ.
example_en: This river is the original source of water for this region.

definition: a figure or structure that has eight angles.
example_en: They built the eight-angled structure in the middle of the town.

definition: a boiling or bubbling up (as food, milk being cooked); effervescence.
example_en: The milk began to boil and bubble up on the stove.

definition: to eat; to chew; to swallow; to devour.
example_en: The hungry dog was chewing on the bone.

definition: an inflamed pus-filled swelling caused by infection; a boil; an abscess.
example_en: A boil is forming on his leg.

definition: any sport played in or on water; water-sport.
example_en: The children were absorbed in water-sports in the lake.

definition: to go or come near; to approah.
example_en: The child came near its mother and hugged her.

definition: a performer who entertains, as in a circus, by antics, jokes, tricks, etc.; a jester; a clown.
example_en: In the circus, that clown made the children laugh.

definition: an inverted 'V' shaped tile, used to cover the ridge where two sloping roofs of a building meet.
example_en: They fixed the ridge tile on the roof of the house.

definition: an auditor - a) a person authorised to audit accounts of a business organisation etc. b) a public official who audits government accounts, distributes revenues, assesses real-estate, inspects scales, etc.
example_en: The auditor examined the company's income report.

definition: enthusiasm; zeal.
example: ಹೊಸ ಕೆಲಸ ಆರಂಭಿಸುವ ಉಕ್ಕೆವ ಅವನಲ್ಲಿ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The enthusiasm to start the new job was clearly visible in him.

definition: a broad chest.
example_en: That wrestler had a broad chest.

definition: to trouble, torment; to torture; to harass.
example_en: The officials tortured the prisoner.

definition: to pull with a jerk.
example_en: He pulled the rope with a jerk.

definition: pain in the stomach or abdomen; stomach-ache.
example: ಹಸಿ ಮಾವಿನಹಣ್ಣು ತಿಂದದ್ದರಿಂದ ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ಹೊಟ್ಟೆನೋವು ಬಂತು.
example_en: Because the child ate raw mango, it got a stomach-ache.

definition: to be harmonious; to be in agreement with.
example_en: The opinions of those two friends were in agreement.

definition: to get some space.
example_en: In the crowd, he managed to get some space with difficulty.

definition: a captain - a) an important military leader; b) the leader of a sports team; c) the leader of a group of persons (in gen.); d) the person in command of a merchant or passenger ship.
example_en: The ship's captain gave orders to the crew.

definition: a game of chance for money or some other stake.
example_en: He lost a good deal of money in the game of chance.

definition: perceived through the ear; heard.
example_en: That news was heard by everyone.

definition: one of the seven nether regions (believed to be below the earth.
example: ಪುರಾಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸುತಳವು ಭೂಮಿಯ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಒಂದು ಲೋಕವೆಂದು ಹೇಳಲಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: In the puranas, Sutala is said to be one of the nether regions below the earth.

definition: warm affection; close attachment ( esp. of lovers).
example_en: A warm affection grew between the two of them.

definition: unsuccessful - a) not coming about; not taking place or turning out to be as was hoped for; b) having failed to achieve success; not attaining or resulting in success.
example_en: The effort did not bear fruit and he became unsuccessful.

definition: a disguised person.
example_en: The disguised person disappeared into the crowd.

definition: a man possessing sacred knowledge (as taught by the upanishads), knowing and realising the Supreme Spirit.
example: ಆ ಸಂತ ನಿಜವಾದ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಜ್ಞ ಎಂದು ಜನರು ಗೌರವಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: People revered that saint as a true knower of the Supreme Spirit.

definition: a lash attached to a stick for urging on animals or punishing etc.; a whip.
example_en: The cowherd drove the ox with a whip.

definition: an uproar or commotion.
example_en: A great commotion arose on the road.

definition: to cause to become extinct; to bring an end to the existence of (something).
example_en: This disease brought those birds to extinction.

definition: a street which is desolate.
example_en: There is a desolate street in that village.

definition: touching the heart; affecting the sentiments; evoking sympathy; appealing.
example: ಆ ಮಾರ್ಮಿಕ ಹಾಡು ಎಲ್ಲರ ಕಣ್ಣನ್ನು ಒದ್ದೆ ಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: That heart-touching song made everyone's eyes wet.

definition: light emited by fire.
example_en: The light from the forest fire was visible from afar.

definition: a saluting by touching one's forehead with the tips of the right hand, standing on ones knees.
example_en: The soldiers offered the kneeling salute to the king.

definition: to scatter (seed) over land, earth, etc., for growth; to sow.
example_en: The farmer sowed seeds in the land during the rainy season.

definition: care taken beforehand; caution used in advance; precaution.
example: ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಬರುವ ಮುನ್ನ ಜನರು ಮುಂಜಾಗ್ರತೆ ವಹಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: Before the flood came, the people took precaution in advance.

definition: a servile, menial service.
example_en: In that house, they used to make him do menial, servile work.

definition: to see; to look at.
example_en: The child looked at the sky.

definition: the level land contiguous to a mountain.
example_en: The villagers grow crops on the land near the foot of the mountain.

definition: a useless, ineffectual man.
example_en: The family used to call him an ineffectual man.

definition: a light, three-wheeled vehicle, with one wheel in front and two in back; a tricycle.
example_en: The child is riding a tricycle and going around the lane.

definition: shelter or protection from danger, difficulty, etc.; refuge.
example_en: The devotee sought refuge in God.

definition: a day free from celebrations, busy schedule of work, etc.; a free day.
example_en: Sunday was a free day for him.

definition: to move about or to and fro; to waver; to oscilate; to quiver.
example_en: The door curtain was swaying to and fro in the wind.

definition: lack of space or opportunity for giving out smoke; the condition that does not allow even smoke to come out.
example: ಗುಹೆಯೊಳಗೆ ನಿರ್ಧಾಮಧೂಮದ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಇತ್ತು, ಹೊಗೆ ಹೊರಬರಲು ದಾರಿಯೇ ಇರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Inside the cave there was a state where even smoke could not find a way out.

definition: any of the white pawns in chess.
example_en: If you move the white pawn carefully, you can win the game.

definition: the fact of being spread over a wide area.
example_en: The spread of smoke was seen across the whole sky.

definition: to move forward by or as by crawling.
example_en: The worm crawled and moved on the leaf.

definition: the mulberry plant Morus alba of Moraceae family; white mulberry.
example_en: The leaves of the white mulberry are fed to silkworms.

definition: a kind of medicinal herb.
example_en: The doctor used the medicinal herb madhuraka in the medicine.

definition: an instrument for determining the distance of a remote object or distance between two distant objects; a telemeter.
example_en: The astronomers measured the distance of the star with a telemeter.

definition: a thing presented as a gift; a gift; a present.
example: ಅವನು ನನಗೆ ಒಂದು ಸುಂದರ ತೆಲ್ಲಟಿ ಕೊಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: He gave me a beautiful gift.

definition: Křṣṇa, the father of Kāma.
example_en: The poets praised Krishna, the father of Kama, with devotion.

definition: serious attention; solicitude; heed; caution; care.
example: ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಆರೋಗ್ಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಾಯಿ ಜೋಕೆ ವಹಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: The mother took heed and care about her children's health.

definition: the act of refining the thoughts, behaviour, intellect, emotions, tastes, etc.
example_en: Education is helpful for the refinement of thought and behaviour.

definition: a way of doing, being, being done or happening; mode of action, occurrence, etc.: manner.
example_en: The manner of doing this is not correct.

definition: to be able to.
example: ಅವನಿಗೆ ಆ ಭಾರವಾದ ಚೀಲವನ್ನು ಎತ್ತಲು ಕಿಸಿತು.
example_en: He was able to lift that heavy bag.

definition: absolute darkness.
example_en: Absolute darkness had enveloped that valley.

definition: disliking or avoiding work; idle; lazy; inactive.
example_en: Being lazy, he lay down the whole day.

definition: to interrupt, arrest or check (a course, proceeding, process, etc.); to stop.
example: ಪೊಲೀಸರು ಆ ಜಗಳವನ್ನು ತಗೆದು ಶಾಂತಿ ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The police stopped that quarrel and restored peace.

definition: a tax or charge exacted by the state or local authorities for a privilege, esp. for permission to pass over a bridge, along a highway, etc.; toll.
example_en: One must pay a toll to cross the bridge.

definition: a mystic whose faculty of perceiving extends even to what is not within the reach of the senses.
example_en: That mystic perceived what was going to happen beforehand.

definition: the pointed end of a thorn.
example: ಮುಳ್ಳಿನ ಮುಳುಮೊನೆ ಚುಚ್ಚಿ ಅವನ ಬೆರಳು ರಕ್ತಸ್ರಾವವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The sharp point of the thorn pricked and his finger bled.

definition: energy released or absorbed during reactions taking place in atomic nuclei; atomic energy.
example_en: Scientists use atomic energy for generating electricity.

definition: helping to achieve what is desired.
example_en: His effort turned out to help achieve what was desired.

definition: a liberal, generous person.
example_en: That generous man distributed grain to the poor.

definition: the quality or state of being withered, faded, languid, etc.
example_en: The withered state of the flower was clearly visible because of the heat.

definition: a female human being; a woman.
example_en: That woman was breastfeeding the child.

definition: a lonely or deserted or a private place.
example_en: He searched for a lonely place.

definition: a sacrificial oblation made of ground rice and offered in vessels.
example_en: In the sacrifice, they offered the rice oblation in vessels.

definition: a commentary (esp. broadcast) of some activity while it is being carried on.
example_en: The commentary of the match was broadcast on the radio.

definition: lack of attention; neglect.
example_en: His neglect of the work caused him harm.

definition: the eye that is forced by the sleeping instinct to close.
example_en: His sleepy eye closed because of exhaustion.

definition: a high or the highest desire.
example: ಅವಳ ಮನದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿದೇಶ ಪ್ರಯಾಣದ ಹೇರಾಸೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: She had a great desire to travel abroad.

definition: any of various wolflike carnivores (family Hyaenidae), with powerful jaws, a bristly mane, short hind legs, and a characteristic shrill cry, fed on carrion; a hyena.
example_en: The hyena wanders about searching for a corpse.

definition: a particular stage of the infectious venereal disease gonorrhoea, caused by the bacterium gonococci (Neissenia gonorrhoeae).
example_en: The advanced stage of gonorrhoea is caused by the gonococcus bacterium.

definition: the dried, ripe fruit (as coconut).
example_en: They broke the dried coconut and grated it for the festival.

definition: the act of stirring, agitating (a liquid).
example_en: She slowly stirred the milk in the vessel.

definition: a place of origin.
example_en: His place of origin was a different town.

definition: a container to spit into; a cuspidor; a spittoon.
example_en: They had placed a spittoon beside the grandfather.

definition: the central portion of a house.
example_en: They placed the lamp in the central portion of the house.

definition: considered; taken into consideration or account.
example_en: The decision was made after considering all the aspects.

definition: a class of animals having no vertebral column.
example_en: The earthworm is an animal belonging to the invertebrate class.

definition: in a state's economy, that sector which is entirely funded, owned, managed by a private individual, group of individuals, a company, etc. independent of government's help, investment, intervention, etc.; private sector.
example_en: The private sector has increased job opportunities.

definition: the bird francoline partridge.
example_en: The call of the francoline partridge was heard in the forest.

definition: that part of the roof of a building, projecting beyond the wall, sloping outward; the roof-ledge.
example: ಮಳೆ ನೀರು ಚುಂಚುಲೋವೆಯ ಮೇಲಿಂದ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಸುರಿಯುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Rainwater was pouring down from the roof-ledge.

definition: a man (in gen.).
example_en: A man came walking along the forest path.

definition: the quality or state of being abundant, plentiful or copious; copiousness.
example: ಆ ತೋಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಣ್ಣುಗಳ ಪುಷ್ಕಲ ಕಂಡು ಬೆರಗಾದೆವು.
example_en: We were amazed to see the abundance of fruits in that garden.

definition: one of the fourteen Manus, the forefathers of the mankind.
example: ರೌಚ್ಯನು ಹದಿನಾಲ್ಕು ಮನುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬನಾಗಿ ಮಾನವಕುಲದ ಮೂಲಪುರುಷನಾದನು.
example_en: Rauchya, one of the fourteen Manus, became a forefather of mankind.

definition: to be delighted.
example_en: The mother was delighted seeing the child's smile.

definition: to go back to original or previous place; to retreat.
example_en: The frightened soldiers retreated backward.

definition: the Kannaḍa language.
example_en: He writes well in the Kannada language.

definition: one of the eight forms of marriage in which the bride's father receives one or two pairs of cows from the bridegroom.
example_en: In the arsha marriage, the bridegroom gives cows.

definition: a year.
example_en: Every year they come to the village.

definition: the condition of being sightless; blindness.
example_en: After the accident, blindness came upon him.

definition: to find out or estimate the extent, dimensions, etc. of, esp. by the use of a standard; to measure.
example_en: The mason measured the height of the wall.

definition: a courageous man (esp. a soldier).
example_en: The courageous soldier faced the enemies in battle.

definition: the act of observing; attention; regard; heed; cognisance; notice.
example: ಗುರುಗಳು ಶಿಷ್ಯನ ಪ್ರಗತಿಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅರುವು ಇಟ್ಟಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: The teacher kept heed of the student's progress.

definition: the condition of being directed or restrained; a being under control.
example_en: It is good to be under control.

definition: to fall en masse as to make a heap.
example_en: In the rain all the leaves fell in a heap.

definition: she who has renounced customs.
example_en: That woman who renounced customs gave up traditional restrictions.

definition: the act of retreating or withdrawing in the face of opposition or from a difficult venture.
example_en: The army did not retreat in the face of the enemy.

definition: a kind of cloth or garment.
example_en: She had a beautiful vaḍanji cloth on her body.

definition: land well above sea level; highland.
example_en: A cool breeze blows in the highland.

definition: any of the pieces of hard tissue that make up the skeleton of a vertebrate animal, and consist largely of calcium phosphate or carbonate in a matrix of collagen fibres; a bone.
example_en: That animal's bone is kept in the museum.

definition: a daughter of a king; a princess.
example_en: The king's daughter wore beautiful ornaments.

definition: to be long or longer; to be elongated.
example_en: This creeper elongates quickly.

definition: strongly; intensely; with strong emotion.
example_en: He embraced intensely and wept.

definition: the part of sugar cane left after the juice has been extracted or the residue of certain other processed plants, left outs of cattle fodder.
example_en: The sugarcane residue is used as fodder for cattle.

definition: a poor man; a destitute.
example_en: That destitute man had no means even for food.

definition: allowed to be seen; disclosed; revealed; exhibited.
example_en: The truth was revealed before everyone.

definition: a screen made by weaving thin strips of bamboo, used as a partition wall, screen, etc.
example_en: They put up a bamboo screen in the courtyard to block the wind.

definition: to get formed a hem on a cloth; to double down the border of a cloth; to get sewn a cloth adding a border to it.
example_en: The grandmother got a hem sewn on the new saree.

definition: a multitude of water lily plants.
example_en: A multitude of water lily plants had spread thickly in that lake.

definition: a small, open container for drinking beverages.
example_en: He drank milk from the small drinking container.

definition: the split of tamarind seed.
example_en: The grandmother was drying the split tamarind seeds in the sun.

definition: an excessive response to stimulation in the body; a condition of soreness or inflammation in some organ or part.
example_en: Soreness and inflammation appeared around the wound.

definition: an earthen vessel.
example_en: The potter made a new earthen vessel out of clay.

definition: the head of a small military platoon, police team or group of menial servants.
example_en: The platoon head led his team to the border.

definition: a beautiful upper portion (as the round tomb-like structure) of a building.
example_en: The beautiful upper portion of the temple is visible from afar.

definition: soaked thoroughly.
example_en: The cloth soaked in the rain was thoroughly drenched.

definition: to keep (something) at the back of.
example_en: Grandfather kept the old box at the back of the room.

definition: a ruler; a king.
example_en: The king defeated the enemies and protected the kingdom.

definition: the quality of a wicked person; wickedness.
example_en: His wickedness was exposed in front of everyone.

definition: closet or cabinet with shelves for holding cups, plates, food, and the like; a cupboard; an almirah.
example_en: She kept the plates in the cupboard.

definition: a cessation of a warfare; cease-fire.
example_en: The two countries declared a cease-fire.

definition: the overcoming of an enemy or antagonist.
example: ರಾಜನ ಜಯ್ಯ ಇಡೀ ರಾಜ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಭ್ರಮ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The king's victory over the enemy brought joy across the whole kingdom.

definition: a slender, sharp, pointed instrument used for writing, etching, engraving, etc.; a stylus.
example_en: The craftsman etched a design with the stylus.

definition: the scientific study of the life and culture of past, esp. ancient, peoples, as by excavation of ancient cities, relics, artifacts, etc.; archaeology.
example: ಆ ವಿದ್ವಾಂಸ ಪ್ರಾಕ್ತನಶಾಸ್ತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಳವಾದ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: That scholar has deep knowledge of archaeology.

definition: to lend; to loan - a) to grant (to a person) the use of (a thing) on the understanding that it or its equivalent shall be returned; b) to allow the use of (money) usu. at interest.
example: ಬಡ ರೈತನಿಗೆ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿ ಹಣ ಕಡಗುಡಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The moneylender lent money to the poor farmer.

definition: the act of entering in; entrance.
example_en: The entrance near the door was narrow.

definition: the water cane Calamus rotang of Arecaceae family.
example_en: They weave baskets from the water cane.

definition: to breathe with effort (as in choking or from a disease); to gasp.
example: ಮೆಟ್ಟಿಲು ಹತ್ತಿ ಬಂದ ಮುದುಕ ಉಗರಿಸುತ್ತಾ ಕುಳಿತನು.
example_en: The old man who climbed the stairs sat down gasping for breath.

definition: to be yoked; to be harnessed to a yoke.
example_en: The oxen are yoked to the cart.

definition: the state of being very plentiful; copiousness; plentifulness; abundance.
example_en: This year, an abundance of crops was seen.

definition: a river in central India, flowing from the Western Ghats into the Bay of Bengal (900 mi. 1,440 km).
example_en: The Godavari river flows from the Western Ghats.

definition: the quality or condition of being virtuous, sinless, holy, etc.
example_en: The saint's life was full of purity and virtue.

definition: a region abounding in big rocks and boulders.
example_en: There is a region abounding in boulders around that hill.

definition: a developing or being developed.
example_en: The government provided funds for the development of the village.

definition: a more than sufficient quantity or number; the state or quality of being so.
example_en: This year, more than sufficient production has been seen.

definition: the back part of the human foot; the heel.
example_en: The thorn pricked his heel.

definition: a piece of broken pottery; a pot-sherd.
example_en: Broken pot-sherds lay scattered in the courtyard.

definition: footwear as slippers made of leather.
example_en: He set out wearing leather slippers.

definition: to impede; to obstruct.
example_en: The rival obstructed his plan.

definition: to engage in wrestling; to wrestle.
example_en: Two wrestlers wrestled at the fair.

definition: a hardened and tempered steel chisel without a handle, for cutting or chipping cold metal; a cold chisel.
example_en: The blacksmith cut the iron with the cold chisel.

definition: to become dark; to become obscure.
example_en: As evening fell, the sky became dark and obscure.

definition: great amazement; bewildering surprise.
example: ಅವನ ಸಾಧನೆಯನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಜನರಿಗೆ ಕಟ್ಟಚ್ಚರಿ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: Seeing his achievement, people were struck with great amazement.

definition: an iron rod.
example_en: The blacksmith heated the iron rod in fire and bent it.

definition: an agreed or regular meeting place; a rendezvous.
example_en: Let us meet at that rendezvous in the evening.

definition: storm accompanied by rain.
example_en: A storm with rain blew in the village and ruined the crop.

definition: (termites) to eat away (wooden articles or articles).
example_en: The termites have eaten away the wooden pillars of the house.

definition: a window having a lattice.
example_en: Cool breeze was entering through the lattice window.

definition: to increase by three times.
example_en: The merchant increased his capital by three times.

definition: praised; lauded; applauded; commended.
example_en: His service is praised everywhere.

definition: conventional or customary talk.
example_en: Grandfather often spoke in customary sayings.

definition: a wandering or roaming about.
example_en: His wandering went on from village to village.

definition: differing one from another; of several kinds; various.
example_en: Various kinds of goods were for sale in that shop.

definition: the act or an instance of cheating; a dishonest action or trick; fraud; deceit.
example_en: He stole the money through fraud.

definition: a master, owner or employer.
example: ಅವನು ಆ ಅಂಗಡಿಯ ವಲ್ಲಹ ಎಂದು ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಗೊತ್ತು.
example_en: Everyone knows that he is the owner of that shop.

definition: the consciousness of being a true and loyal citizen of a nation.
example_en: At school, the consciousness of being a loyal citizen is cultivated in children.

definition: (tightness, stiffness) to become severe, intense.
example_en: His joint pain became severe during winter.

definition: prime youth.
example_en: She was very beautiful in her prime youth.

definition: the state of passions being controlled or subjugated.
example_en: A state of subdued passions is seen in ascetics.

definition: a note of comment or reference at the bottom of a page.
example_en: The author has written a footnote at the bottom of the page.

definition: a tree bearing fruits.
example: ತೋಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ಫಲಿ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಫಲ ಬಿಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: That fruit-bearing tree yielded fruit well in the garden.

definition: a trial impression taken forchecking errors, making corrections before final printing; a proof.
example_en: They checked the proof of the book and made corrections.

definition: a woman who obtains men and women for the purpose of prostitution; a procuress.
example: ಆ ಕುಂಟಣಿ ಊರಿನ ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಕ್ಕಳನ್ನು ಕೆಟ್ಟ ದಾರಿಗೆ ಎಳೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: That procuress was luring the girls of the town into a bad path.

definition: to become glossy, shiny.
example_en: After applying oil, the hair became glossy.

definition: a plant.
example_en: The kāḍu bambe plant grows at the edge of the forest.

definition: the ruddy goose, the male and female of which are supposed to be together always.
example_en: A pair of ruddy geese was swimming in the lake.

definition: to be subject to derision; to be ridiculed.
example_en: Because of his mistake, the whole family became subject to ridicule.

definition: the tree Spathodea campanulata of Bignoniaceae family; water squirt tree.
example: ತೋಟದಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರುಗೋೞಿ ಮರ ಕೆಂಪು ಹೂ ಬಿಟ್ಟಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The water squirt tree in the garden had bloomed red flowers.

definition: anything that is used to decorate the head.
example_en: There were pearl ornaments in the bride's head decoration.

definition: to beat to pulp or powder; to pound; to pulverise.
example_en: She pounded the dry chillies into powder.

definition: a slow-witted prson.
example: ಗುಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ಮಜಡನನ್ನು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಗೇಲಿ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone mocked that slow-witted person in the group.

definition: a playing card with a conventionalized picture of a royal male servant or soldier on it; a knave; a jack.
example_en: That playing card jack remained in his hand.

definition: to swell and move in undulated manner.
example_en: In the wind the cloth swelled and moved in waves as it flew.

definition: a strong, well-built, robust man.
